assumptions.revenue: Completed orders only; line_total is the discounted sale amount; approved refunds are capped at the line amount and allocated to the sale month.
assumptions.ltv: Completed orders with a known customer only; net lifetime value is discounted line revenue less approved refunds.
assumptions.segment: Customer count uses the current cleansed customer dimension; average order value uses completed orders and discounted line totals.
assumptions.channel_growth: Completed orders only; revenue is discounted line revenue and growth is compared with the immediately preceding calendar month.
assumptions.return_rate: Approved returned quantity divided by ordered quantity; products must meet the configured minimum ordered-unit threshold.
assumptions.supplier_score: Composite score = 50% revenue share + 30% inverse average return rate + 20% normalized supplier rating.
assumptions.repeat_rate: A repeat customer has a second distinct completed order within the configured window after the first completed order.
assumptions.payments: Successful payment rows are summed; the configured tolerance determines match, underpayment, and overpayment. Every cleansed order is reported.
assumptions.margin: Effective selling price is unit_price after line discount; products are reported when cost_price exceeds that effective price.
